criterion_descriptions: Navigate to the HD 209458 b overview page and attempt to view the 'Architecture & Discovery Information' block. Full credit if the agent attempts access but the site/page/block is unavailable (down, blocked, infinite loading, captcha) and the agent clearly reports the issue. Partial credit if the agent reaches the page but it is unclear whether the correct block was located.

Evaluate whether the agent sourced information exclusively from the single 'Architecture & Discovery Information' row and did not use other sections (e.g., Planetary Parameters). Full credit if only that block is used and the agent stops after reporting exactly the eight requested fields. Partial credit if the correct block is used but extra, unrequested fields/sections are included. No credit if values are substituted from other tables/sources when the Architecture & Discovery Information block is available. If the block is inaccessible/unavailable and the agent states this, do not penalize here for inability to comply; score based on the access criterion instead.

Provide the stellar-host name exactly as displayed in the Architecture & Discovery Information row. Full credit for exact match. Partial credit for minor transcription issues (e.g., spacing) that do not change the entity. No credit for reporting a different host or leaving it out when the block is available. If the block is unavailable and the agent clearly reports that, award full credit for not fabricating a value.

Provide the planet name exactly as displayed in the Architecture & Discovery Information row. Full credit for exact match. Partial credit for minor transcription issues that do not change the entity. No credit for wrong planet or omission when the block is available. If the block is unavailable and the agent clearly reports that, award full credit for not fabricating a value.

Record the Orbital Separation value exactly as shown (including number and units) in the Architecture & Discovery Information block. Full credit for exact value and units with no conversions. Partial credit if units are missing but the numeric value is correct as displayed. No credit if value is taken from another table, converted, inferred, or incorrect when the block is available. If the block is unavailable and the agent clearly reports that, award full credit for not fabricating a value.

Record the Planet Size value exactly as shown (including number and units) in the Architecture & Discovery Information block. Full credit for exact value and units with no conversions. Partial credit if units are missing but the numeric value is correct as displayed. No credit if value is taken from another table, converted, inferred, or incorrect when the block is available. If the block is unavailable and the agent clearly reports that, award full credit for not fabricating a value.

Report the discovery method exactly as displayed in the Architecture & Discovery Information row. Full credit for exact wording/capitalization as shown. Partial credit for minor wording/case differences that clearly refer to the same method. No credit for wrong method or omission when the block is available. If the block is unavailable and the agent clearly reports that, award full credit for not fabricating a value.

Report the discovery year exactly as displayed in the Architecture & Discovery Information row. Full credit for correct year. Partial credit if year is correct but presented with minor extra text. No credit for incorrect year or omission when the block is available. If the block is unavailable and the agent clearly reports that, award full credit for not fabricating a value.

Report the reference exactly as displayed in the Architecture & Discovery Information row (preserving names/formatting text as shown). Full credit for exact transcription. Partial credit if the correct reference is identifiable but with minor truncation/formatting loss. No credit for wrong reference, substituted literature citation, or omission when the block is available. If the block is unavailable and the agent clearly reports that, award full credit for not fabricating a value.

Report the disposition exactly as displayed in the Architecture & Discovery Information row. Full credit for exact match. Partial credit for minor transcription/case differences. No credit for incorrect disposition or omission when the block is available. If the block is unavailable and the agent clearly reports that, award full credit for not fabricating a value.
